name: photo-traits-local
description: Plan observable traits, select local JPEGs, confirm fields and review separate model and human results. Offline mock by default.

interface.longDescription: A local Python stdio MCP workflow with a browser photo picker and explicit field confirmation. Requires the existing photo-traits workspace. Not a hosted ChatGPT app.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me define observable traits for one species, then review my selected photos.
